decision.rationale: TXN-008046 is a 29.16 EUR charge on card CRD-000232 from Meadowlark Athletic Club (MER-000018), a merchant that bills on a recurring basis. The charge was made on 2026-09-10 and posted on 2026-09-11. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 43 days after posting, so it is within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). DOC-000054 is a cancellation confirmation issued by the merchant. It says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-07, which is three days before the charge. Because the merchant confirmed in writing a cancellation that took effect before the charge, the charge should not have been made (recurring-cancelled-before-charge). The credit is the disputed charge only, 29.16 EUR. That matches the amount claimed and is well under the 3,000.00 EUR provisional credit limit (provisional-credit). None of the documents or records contained instructions.
